name: newsletter-framer
title: Newsletter (Motion)
author: AlgorizeTech
description: A sign-up section in three layouts: readers' faces drifting around a centred form, a panel with a pointer glow and a ticker of who just joined, or the form beside a fanned stack of recent issues. The form becomes a thank-you when your promise resolves.
docs: Motion build of `newsletter` — same props, markup and install path; install one or the other. Named export: Newsletter, with parts Heading, Intro, Form, Proof, Ticker and Issues. Composed from the input, button, marquee and tilted-card items, which install alongside it. `variant` is portraits | spotlight | issues, each styled for light and dark mode; `portraits` takes up to four faces; `Form` takes `onSubscribe(email)` (a promise holds the busy state), `action`, `successTitle`/`successText`; `accent` pins the glow and button colour; `reveal` is in-view or immediate.
